Package com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client.sso.entity

package com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client.sso.entity
Maps the request/response payloads used by the OAuth/IDCS authentication flows in com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client.sso. Internal implementation package of simple POJOs with no behavior; not part of the public API.

    com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client.sso
    OAuth/IDCS authentication flows (authorization code, device code, JWT assertion) for connecting to EPM Cloud environments that require single sign-on rather than native username/password credentials.

    AccessTokenResponse
    Maps the token response returned by IDCS/OCI IAM (Oracle's identity service) token endpoints, such as those used by the device code and JWT-assertion flows.
    DeviceCode
